annotation.interpretation_a: The server can send up to three datagrams: one Initial packet and two Handshake packets, before needing a response.
annotation.interpretation_b: The server can send up to three datagrams of *any* combination of Initial and Handshake packets, so three Initial packets, three Handshake packets, or any mix, before needing a response.
annotation.justification: The phrase 'three datagrams including Initial and Handshake packets' is open to interpretation. Does 'including' mean the total number of Initial and Handshake packets combined cannot exceed three, or that the three datagrams can be any combination of Initial and Handshake packets? Both interpretations are reasonable.
annotation.missing_information: It is unclear whether 'including' modifies 'Initial and Handshake packets' as a unit, or applies to each type of packet individually. A clearer phrasing would specify the maximum number of each packet type allowed.
